tools.description: Update your card; move todo to doing, or held work to review/done. Review requires question, context and at least two options. Requesters may edit their own review details while preserving the open ask. Assignee edits and ask withdrawal to todo/doing are prepared for future agent-directed reviews; current APIs create person-directed reviews, which agents cannot withdraw or complete. Reopen done to todo (status only). Save a lesson with done. Trusted agents may move available backlog cards of unrestricted origin to todo or doing and add lessons, PR links or memory links to done cards. callstack takes the JSON from python -m commonplace.callstack.
